meta.name: Nocturne
meta.description: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

videos.title: Lazarus, Come Forth!
videos.overview: A missing boy returns home after three years, reigniting a frantic search for his sister.

videos.title: For Such a Time as This
videos.overview: The discovery of an old accomplice throws a wrench in the case. Saga volunteers to go undercover.

videos.title: Eyes on the Inside
videos.overview: When communication goes dark, Saga must get creative. Jonah investigates a cryptic symbol.

videos.title: The Courier
videos.overview: Saga inches closer to Jurek while a risky plan takes shape to ensnare his messenger.

videos.title: Solitude
videos.overview: Determined to find answers, Jonah pieces together a chilling theory about Jurek's true motive.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.overview: Jonah makes a grim discovery in the woods. Saga goes to extreme lengths to win Jurek over.

videos.title: Grey Skies
videos.overview: Tensions inside the facility reach a breaking point as Jurek makes his boldest move yet.
